findings.claim: The golden pins `sync-check --target opencode` as 'target dir not found ... skipping'. The skills directory is no longer created, so sync-check stops looking at the OpenCode native agents in ~/.config/opencode/agents. Drift in those agents used to be reported as UPSTREAM_CHANGED or OVERLAY_NOT_DEPLOYED and now goes unreported. The agents are still deployed, so this is lost coverage for files that are still managed.

The commit exists to stop OpenCode skill copies from shadowing the Claude skills, but it leaves the copies an earlier apply made in ~/.config/opencode/skills in place. The changelog admits this. Existing installs keep the shadowing, and apply no longer touches that directory, so nothing in labdrian repairs it or even flags it. Only a manual cleanup fixes it.

evidence: The diff gates only the mkdir in apply.sh on copies_skills; the engine routing change makes opencode skill rows have an empty destination.
The golden shows the opencode sync-check output reduced to a skip line, and the status output reduced to the agents row only.
